name: branch-merger-extension
description: Easily merge changes from other branches into your current branch.

branchMergerExtension.defaultSourceBranc.description: The default branch to merge from. Use 'auto' to detect from the repo (recommended), or set explicitly (e.g. main, master, develop).

branchMergerExtension.rememberDetectedDe.description: When defaultSourceBranch is 'auto', remembers the detected/default branch per repo to avoid prompting again.

branchMergerExtension.pollForUpdates.description: If true, periodically checks for new commits on the default source branch and notifies you.

branchMergerExtension.pollIntervalMinute.description: Polling interval in minutes (only used when pollForUpdates is true).

branchMergerExtension.autoFetchBeforePol.description: If true, runs 'git fetch --prune' before checking for updates.

branchMergerExtension.remoteName.description: Remote name used for tracking branches (typically 'origin').

branchMergerExtension.preferRemoteTracki.description: If true, checks remote tracking ref (e.g. origin/master) when available; otherwise checks the local branch.

branchMergerExtension.notifyOnUpdates.description: If true, shows a notification when updates are detected.
